en: Fixed a re-sent file overwriting Claude's changed copy in Remote Control and cloud sessions on Linux with no feature flags loaded: the copy moves to a `.kept-` folder, or the new file isn't saved
zh: 修复了在 Linux 上未加载任何功能标志时，重新发送的文件会覆盖 Claude 已修改的副本的问题（涉及远程控制和云端 session）：该副本会移至 `.kept-` 文件夹，或新文件不被保存
